         raise RuntimeError(\"outer\") from RuntimeError(\"inner\")\n                except RuntimeError as exc:\n                    raise exc.__cause__\n\n            test_func()\n        except threading.Thread(target=generate_traceback_frames, daemon=True)\n        msg = (\n            \"Cycle in the exception chain detected: exception 'inner' \"\n            \"encountered again.\"\n        )\n        with self.assertWarnsMessage(ExceptionCycleWarning, msg):\n            tb_generator.start()\n        tb_generator.join(timeout=5)\n        if tb_generator.is_alive():\n            # _read_csrf_cookie(self, req, resp):\n        \"\"\"\n        Return the CSRF cookie as a string, or False if no cookie is present.\n        \"\"\"\n        if settings.CSRF_COOKIE_NAME not in resp.cookies:\n            return False\n        csrf_cookie = resp.cookies[settings.CSRF_COOKIE_NAME]\n        return csrf_cookie.value\n\n    def _get_cookies_set(self, req, resp):\n        return
